questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③은 '안전한 : 안전' 형용사-명사 관계 ≠ '무거운 : 무겁게' 형용사-부사 관계이므로 짝지어진 관계가 어색하다. ①반의어 관계, ②유의어 관계, ④상위어-하위어 관계, ⑤동사-명사 관계로 일관성이 있다.

options: We often __________ on the grass after a walk.
Korean people __________ to their parents on New Year's Day.
The players __________ their arms and legs after games.
questions.question:
다음 중 <보기>의 단어가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?

<보기> mean, bow, think, stretch, understand

① He can __________ Spanish very well.
② We often __________ on the grass after a walk.
③ "Red" can __________ danger in many cultures.
④ Korean people __________ to their parents on New Year's Day.
⑤ The players __________ their arms and legs after games.
questions.explanation: '생각하다'라는 뜻의 think가 들어갈 수 있는 문장이 없고, ②는 '우리는 산책 후에 종종 풀밭에 눕는다.'는 의미를 이루는 lie down(눕다)이 들어갈 수 있다. ①understand, ③mean, ④bow, ⑤stretch가 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 영영풀이가 알맞은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?

<보기>
ⓐ trust: a strong belief in the truth, or ability of someone or something
ⓑ fear: a state of joy, satisfaction, or pleasure
ⓒ comfortable: feeling pleasant and free from pain
ⓓ curious: showing no particular preference or concern
ⓔ action: something that people do, like running, talking, or working
questions.explanation: 알맞은 것은 ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓔ이다. ⓑ fear는 '무언가에 대해 강한 걱정이나 염려를 느끼는 감정'이고, ⓓ curious는 '무언가에 관심이 있고, 더 알고 싶어 하는'의 뜻이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장의 개수는?

ⓐ When is the movie start?
ⓑ We expect win the game.
ⓒ What are you reading now?
ⓓ He will agree to join our team.
ⓔ You need to getting some rest.
ⓕ Whose book this is on the table?
questions.explanation: ⓐ is → does (의문사 의문문 형태 오류), ⓑ win → to win (expect는 to부정사 목적어), ⓔ getting → get (need는 to부정사 목적어), ⓕ this is → is this (Whose 의문문 어순)의 4개가 어법상 어색하다.

options: I choose to stay at home today.
My dream is to travel the world.
We wish to spend more time together.
She plans to bake cookies this weekend.
questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?

They hope to win the soccer game
questions.explanation: 제시문의 to win은 hope의 목적어 자리에 쓰인 to부정사이다. ③의 to travel은 be동사인 is의 보어 자리에 쓰인 명사적 용법의 to부정사이므로 쓰임이 다르다. 나머지는 모두 동사의 목적어 자리에 쓰인 to부정사이다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?

B: Mom, there's my English teacher, Ms. Lee.
W: ___________________________________________
B: She has long brown hair. She is wearing a green jacket.
W: Oh, that's her! Let's say hello to her.

ⓐ How does she look?
ⓑ What is she looking at?
ⓒ What does she look like?
ⓓ What color does she like?
ⓔ What do you think about her?
ⓕ Do you know the woman over there?
questions.explanation: 빈칸 뒤에서 B가 선생님의 외모를 묘사하고 있으므로 선생님이 어떻게 생겼는지를 묻는 표현인 ⓐ 'How does she look?'과 ⓒ 'What does she look like?'가 알맞다.

options: How does the baby cat on the tree feel?
What do the members in the Center do?
What color is the baby cat?
How old is the baby cat?
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?

I'm Michael from Animal Care Center. We help street animals. Look at the baby cat on the tree! It is gray, and it has black ears. It is scared. Let's help it! Whew, it is safe now. Many street animals need our help. We need volunteers. Can you help us, please?
questions.explanation: 글에서는 고양이의 생김새에 대해 말하고 있지만, 고양이의 나이에 대해서는 언급하지 않았으므로 ⑤ '새끼 고양이는 몇 살인가?'는 답할 수 없는 질문이다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것의 개수는?

Hojin: Jenny, ______________________________________?
Jenny: Sure, Hojin. What's up?
Hojin: I can't find my dog, Bella.
Jenny: Really? What does Bella look like?
Hojin: She is white and yellow. She has big ears.
Jenny: Okay. Let's find her together.
Hojin: Thank you so much.

ⓐ how may I help you
ⓑ do you need a hand
ⓒ can you do me a favor
ⓓ may I ask for your help
ⓔ can you help me, please
ⓕ could you give me a hand
questions.explanation: 빈칸 뒤에서 Jenny는 '물론이지'라고 답하며 무슨 일인지 묻고 있으므로 도움을 요청하는 표현이 들어가야 한다. 따라서 ⓒ, ⓓ, ⓔ, ⓕ의 4개가 알맞다.

questions.question:
위 대화를 읽고 다음 질문에 대한 알맞은 답을 아래와 같이 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하시오.

Q. What will Jenny and Hojin do after the conversation?
→ They _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________, _____________ together. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 대화가 끝난 후 Jenny와 Hojin은 호진이의 강아지 Bella를 찾을 것이다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

What ⓐdo these dogs want to say?
The first dog is bowing. It is saying, "I want to play with you." The dog feels excited, and it wants to have fun right now. ⓑLooks at the second dog. The dog's head is low, its ears are back, and its tail is down. This body language shows fear. The dog is scared of something. It needs ⓒbe alone for a moment.

What are these rabbits ⓓthink?
The first rabbit is standing on its back legs. It is raising its front legs, and its ears are straight. Is it worried about something? Not really. The rabbit is curious about something. The second rabbit is ⓔlying down like Superman. It is stretching its legs. Why is it doing that? Is it sick? Don't worry. The rabbit is saying, "I feel so ⓕcomfortably."

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 알맞은 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 어법상 어색한 것은: ⓑ Looks → Look (명령문), ⓒ be → to be (need는 to부정사), ⓓ think → thinking (현재진행형), ⓕ comfortably → comfortable (feel의 보어는 형용사). 어법상 알맞은 것은 ⓐ, ⓔ의 2개이므로 어색한 것은 4개이다.

options: It is wagging its tail and jumping.
It is stretching its legs like Superman.
It's ears are forward, and the tail is down.
Its head and its tail are low and its ears are back.
It is standing on its back legs and its ears are straight.
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고, 겁먹은 개의 행동으로 알맞은 것을 고르시오.

다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

What do these dogs want to say?
The first dog is bowing. It is saying, "I want to play with you." The dog feels excited, and it wants to have fun right now. Look at the second dog. The dog's head is low, its ears are back, and its tail is down. This body language shows fear. The dog is scared of something. It needs to be alone for a moment.
questions.explanation: 글에서 무서워하는 개는 머리가 낮고, 귀는 뒤로 향하며, 꼬리는 아래로 내려가 있다고 설명했으므로 ④가 정답이다.

options: ⓐ: 'Let's+동사원형'은 '~하자'라는 제안의 표현이므로 Let's 뒤에 동사원형 learn이 쓰였다.
ⓑ: 의문사 How가 쓰인 의문문으로, 일반동사 feel이 있으며 주어가 복수명사구 these cats이므로 조동사 do가 쓰였다.
ⓒ: 대명사 this는 the first cat을 가리킨다.
ⓓ: '~처럼 보이다'라는 뜻으로 like 뒤에 명사구 a question mark가 쓰인 것은 알맞다.
ⓔ: want는 to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이므로 wants 뒤에 쓰인 to부정사 to have는 알맞다.
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

Do you like animals? Can you understand them well? Let's ⓐlearn about their feelings in the next quiz.

How ⓑdo these cats feel?
The first cat is showing its belly. What does ⓒthis mean? Is it afraid of something? Not at all! This action shows its trust. The cat also feels safe now. The second cat's ears are forward, and the tail is up. Its tail ⓓlooks like a question mark. How does the cat feel? It feels happy. Maybe it also wants ⓔto have playtime.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에 대한 설명으로 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ 대명사 this는 '첫 번째 고양이가 배를 드러내는 것'(the first cat의 행동)을 가리킨다. 주어 자체가 아니라 그 이전의 행동을 가리킨다.

options:

(B) The cat is curious about something.

(A) The cat is happy now.
(B) The cat feels safe with you.

(A) The cat is happy now.

(A)______________________ (B)______________________
questions.explanation: 귀가 앞으로 향하고, 꼬리가 위로 향한 고양이는 행복한 감정을 느낀다. 배를 보이는 고양이의 행동은 신뢰를 보이고 안전함을 느낀다는 뜻이므로 (A) The cat is happy now, (B) The cat feels safe with you가 정답이다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 Jinho와 Minji가 나눈 대화가 다음과 같을 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

How do these cats feel?
The first cat is showing its belly. What does this mean? Is it afraid of something? Not at all! This action shows its trust. The cat also feels safe now. The second cat's ears are forward, and the tail is up. Its tail looks like a question mark. How does the cat feel? It feels happy. Maybe it also wants to have playtime.

What are these rabbits thinking?
The first rabbit is standing on its back legs. It is raising its front legs, and its ears are straight. Is it worried about something? Not really. The rabbit is curious about something. The second rabbit is lying down like Superman. It is stretching its legs. Why is it doing that? Is it sick? Don't worry. The rabbit is saying, "I feel so comfortable."

A: Look! The first rabbit is standing on its _____________ legs.
B: Yeah! It's raising its _____________ legs and its ears are _____________.
A: Is it worried about something?
B: No. The rabbit is just _____________ about something.
A: Oh, I see! What about the second rabbit? It's _____________ _____________ like Superman!
B: Yes. It's stretching its legs.
A: Is it sick?
B: No, don't worry! It is just saying it feels so _____________. ※ 빈칸 부분만 작성하세요.
questions.explanation: 본문의 내용을 기반으로 각 빈칸에 맞는 단어를 찾아 작성하는 문제이다.

questions.answer: up, looks like a question mark
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

How do these cats feel?
The first cat is showing its belly. What does this mean? Is it afraid of something? Not at all! This action shows its trust. The cat also feels safe now. The second cat's ears are forward, and the tail is up. Its tail looks like a question mark. How does the cat feel? It feels happy. Maybe it also wants to have playtime.

What do these dogs want to say?
The first dog is bowing. It is saying, "I want to play with you." The dog feels excited, and it wants to have fun right now. Look at the second dog. The dog's head is low, its ears are back, and its tail is down. This body language shows fear. The dog is scared of something. It needs to be alone for a moment.

윗글을 읽고 다음 질문에 대한 알맞은 대답이 되도록 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.

<조건>
• 본문에 있는 단어를 사용할 것
• 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것

Q. What does a cat's tail look like when it feels happy?
→ Its tail is __________ and _________ _________ _________ _________. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 행복한 고양이의 꼬리는 위를 향하고 있으며 물음표처럼 보인다.

options: to understand animals' emotions through their sounds
to show differences between wild and pet animals
to describe the daily habits of cats and dogs
questions.question: 윗글의 목적으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 고양이와 개의 행동을 보여주며 그들이 느끼고 있는 감정과 원하는 바를 설명하고 있으므로 '동물의 몸짓 언어를 설명하기 위해'가 글의 목적으로 가장 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음은 보람중학교 1학년 학생들의 수학여행 공지문이다. 공지문을 보고 아래의 대화문을 <조건>에 알맞게 완성하시오.

School Trip Notice
Date: June 21 (Fri) – June 23 (Sun)
Place: Gyeongju
Activities: Visit Bulguksa and Cheomseongdae
Talent show and Games
Bus leaves at 8:00 a.m. on June 21
Please come to school by 7:20 a.m.
We'll learn about history and culture.
Let's have fun!

<조건>
• (1)~(4)에 적절한 의문사를 사용해 의문문을 만들 것
• do, go on, be, go를 사용할 것 (필요시 변형 할 것)
• 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것

A: Minjun, (1)________ _________ your school trip?
B: It's from June 21 to 23.
A: (2)_______ ______ _______ ________ ______ the trip?
B: We will go to Gyeongju.
A: Wow! (3)________ _________ ________ ________ there?
B: We will go by bus.
A: (4)__________ __________ _________ _________ there?
B: We will visit Bulguksa and Cheomseongdae.
A: What else will you do?
B: We will have a talent show and games.
A: Sounds fun! Enjoy your trip! ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
